title: Guides
subtitle: Bilingual guides with sources and dates; respect the verified/reported/unknown labels.
untranslated: This section is not translated to English yet; the Persian version is shown.
runCommandNote: Execution only from an allowlist with separate consent; guides never auto-run commands.
sharedIntro: Read the common steps once, then use each app’s guide for its installation, models and differences.
sharedRtlTitle: Set up and check RTL in VibeHub
sharedRtlBody: After installing an app, choose Check again. For supported tools, Set up RTL creates a shortcut using bundled files without starting or closing the app. Fully quit the app before opening the RTL shortcut. Diagnostics checks files and paths; verify Persian rendering inside the app itself. See each app’s guide for its support and limitations.

install.title: Install and detect
install.body: Install the app from its official source, then choose Check again in Apps. Select its guide for specific installation instructions.

connect.title: Account and connection
connect.body: Sign in inside the app or configure a supported model connection. Keep API keys out of project files and error reports. Models, quotas and regional terms vary by service; consult the app-specific guide.

verify.title: First task and troubleshooting
verify.body: Start with a small file: ask for an explanation, then a limited change. Read the result and run the relevant check. Use Diagnostics to inspect installation paths and configuration if needed; model and proxy connection tests are separate.
